purpose: Teach: オアシス/戦没/豪雪

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが砂漠のオアシスに行く夢を語られた
lines.en: You know, dear, when I was young my father would talk about his dream of seeing a desert oasis.
lines.style: Slow warm opening on the endearment. Measured literary cadence, softening as the memory unfolds.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、戦没者追悼式に毎年参加されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, and when Grandfather was young he went to the memorial service for the war dead every year, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle affirming hum to start. Slow papery warmth, fond rising lilt on the tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが北海道の豪雪に立ち往生された
lines.en: And dear, when my father was young, he once got stranded in the heavy snow up in Hokkaido.
lines.style: Quiet amusement under the telling. Deliberate pace, a small dry chuckle colouring the snow story.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、戦没者ご遺族の方々と交流されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: When Grandfather was young he used to spend time with the families of the war dead too, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Softer now, half in memory. Unhurried, voice dipping near-whisper before the gentle questioning rise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがオアシスの様な憩いの場をご自宅に作られた
lines.en: You know, dear, my father even made a little resting spot at home when he was young — like his own oasis.
lines.style: Warm settling finality. Slowest line yet, lingering tenderly on the image of home as oasis.
